name: Grain
description: Granular synthesizer: each key plays a cloud of overlapping grains from the loaded sound, with pitch and time independent, from a frozen moment to a slow stretch.

params.name: Position
params.description: Where in the loaded sound the grains are taken from. Each key starts here and Scan moves on from it.

params.name: Scan
params.description: How fast each key travels through the sound, whatever its pitch. Zero freezes a moment, higher moves through it, negative runs backwards.

params.name: Size
params.description: Length of each grain. Short grains turn the sound into a grainy texture; long ones let more of the original through.

params.name: Density
params.description: How many grains overlap at once. Low leaves a pulsing, broken texture; high is a smooth, dense cloud at the same loudness.

params.name: Spray
params.description: Scatters where each grain starts around the reading point. Low stays on one spot; high pulls grains from all over the sound.

params.name: Detune
params.description: Random pitch offset for each grain, up or down. A little thickens the cloud; a lot blurs the pitch.

params.name: Octaves
params.description: Chance that a grain plays an octave up or down, split evenly. Low adds a few glints; at the top no grain stays at the played pitch.

params.name: Shape
params.description: The fade on each grain. Low is a smooth bell; high is a flat top with quick fades, which sounds harder and choppier.

params.name: Reverse
params.description: Chance that a grain plays backwards. At the top every grain is reversed.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long a key takes to fade in. Short speaks at once; long swells in slowly.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long the cloud rings on after a key is let go.

params.name: Spread
params.description: How far the grains are scattered between left and right. Zero keeps every grain in the centre.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Low-pass over the whole cloud. Lower is darker and softer; higher lets the full brightness through.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Overall output level of the instrument.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. An asynchronous granular voice in the usual shape (windowed, overlapping, randomised reads of one stored sound); the grain pool is per key so each key keeps its own envelope and scan position.
